crossRefs.note: You shall diligently keep the commandments of Yahweh your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he has…
When your son asks you in time to come, saying, “What do the testimonies, the statutes, and the ordinances, which…
and keep the instruction of Yahweh your God, to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, his commandments, his…
Blessed are those who keep his statutes, who seek him with their whole heart.
I have rejoiced in the way of your testimonies, as much as in all riches.
Take reproach and contempt away from me, for I have kept your statutes.
Indeed your statutes are my delight, and my counselors.
I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
Now, Israel, listen to the statutes and to the ordinances which I teach you, to do them; that you may live, and go in…
Oh that my ways were steadfast to obey your statutes!
I will give thanks to you with uprightness of heart, when I learn your righteous judgments.

people.name: Egypt

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: These are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the ordinances which Moses spoke to the children of Israel when they came out of Egypt,
translations.bsb: These are the testimonies, statutes, and ordinances that Moses proclaimed to them after they had come out of Egypt,
translations.kjv: These are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which Moses spake unto the children of Israel, after they came forth out of Egypt,
